name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.32: find every transaction on one machine inside one time window. There was no way to do this at all: GET /orders takes only deviceCode, page, size and today=1, settlements take only a limit, the dashboard has no date filter, and the public debug endpoint samples 15 rows. listOrdersInRange existed in storage but was never exposed, and it filters status = 1 because the revenue reports want completed sales - the opposite of what a reconciliation wants, which is usually the transaction that did NOT complete. New GET /machines/:deviceCode/transactions?from&to&basis returns settlements and order lines in the window with no status filter. basis selects which timestamp the window matches: closed is when the session happened, received is when the backend got it, and the two differ for anything the machine queued while offline. Both are returned on every settlement row along with queuedSeconds, so a queued transaction is visible as the gap rather than something you have to know to ask for; anything over an hour is flagged. Orders carry only createTime - that table has no arrival timestamp - so a late order cannot be told from a prompt one, and the response says so rather than letting someone read a delay that is not there. A panel on the Activity tab takes the window, shows both tables and downloads one CSV tagged by record kind. Note the closed basis compares ISO strings as the column stores them; the received basis compares epoch ms and is format-proof, so try it if closed returns less than expected. Cumulative over v6.31.1.
